headline: Google DeepMind and A24 announce a groundbreaking research partnership.

items.title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
items.summary: Google DeepMind and A24 have announced an unprecedented research partnership aimed at exploring new AI applications in the creative industries. This partnership will leverage DeepMind's AI expertise and A24's storytelling prowess to push the boundaries of AI in film and media. The collaboration is expected to result in innovative AI-driven tools and content creation processes. This initiative marks a significant step in integrating AI with artistic and narrative elements.
items.why_it_matters: AI developers can gain insights into new creative applications of AI, expanding potential use cases in media and entertainment.

items.title: Jamesob's guide to running SOTA LLMs locally
items.summary: This GitHub repository provides a comprehensive guide and resources for running state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on local machines. It offers step-by-step instructions for setting up the infrastructure, optimizing performance, and ensuring efficient resource usage. The guide is designed for developers looking to experiment with or deploy LLMs without relying on cloud-based services.

items.title: Claude Code's new features
items.summary: Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, has introduced new features aimed at enhancing developer productivity. These features include natural language commands for executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and managing git workflows. The tool is designed to seamlessly integrate into developers' terminals, offering a more interactive and efficient coding environment.

items.title: How Amazon Bedrock catches AI-generated phishing
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock is enhancing email security by identifying AI-generated phishing attempts. This system uses advanced AI techniques to detect subtle patterns and anomalies typical of AI-generated content, reducing the risk of cyberattacks. The tool aims to protect users by leveraging AI's strengths against AI-driven threats, showcasing the dual role AI plays in both creating and defending against security risks.

all_items.summary: In this post, we share best practices for reliable multi-turn RL training. We cover how to build a training environment you can trust, set up an external evaluation, design a reward aligned with the end task, manage what changes once the agent runs for multiple turns, and monitor the metrics that tell you when to iterate.
